title: For the First Time
lyrics:
[00:00.18]While she's been away
[00:03.28]Living day to day has been tough
[00:12.76]Without her at my side
[00:16.06]Simply being alive's been rough
[00:24.68]And though she won't be gone forever
[00:28.77]There are many times I find it feels that way
[00:37.40]And I'm not trying to forget her
[00:41.30]Just understand how I'll be feeling on that day
[00:49.30]It's just like seeing her
[00:53.65]For the first time
[00:56.59]Again
[01:01.98]It's just like seeing her
[01:06.32]For the first time
[01:09.32]Again
[01:16.36]The time she's not around
[01:19.61]Somewhere out of town has been hard
[01:29.01]But somehow, this old heart
[01:31.86]Found time to work it out this far
[01:41.10]No, I know she's coming home soon
[01:45.04]There are times I find it hard to feel that way
[01:53.65]It's not inside me to forget her
[01:57.56]Just understand how I'll be feeling on that day
